capabilities: Quickly capture plot points as title and one-line blurb notes
View and arrange notes as cards on an interactive graph
Connect notes manually or via wikilinks shown as edges
Regroup and nest notes by dragging, with groups mapped to subfolders
Color-code cards and open the underlying note from a card
extras: The listing carries the warning 'This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.' Notes store positions in frontmatter, and the plugin's folder cannot be the vault root.
problem: Obsidian's graph view only shows links between existing notes and Canvas requires manual card setup, so writers and game masters lack a fast way to capture plot points and see them grouped and connected as cards.
summary: Plot and campaign note capture tool that stores each plot point as a plain markdown note and arranges, connects, and groups them on an interactive card graph.
